name: @agentwares/agentguard-core
description: Policy engine behind okgate (formerly agentguard): spend caps, destructive-action gating with approvals, kill switch, scoped agent keys, dry-run writes, semantic loop breaker, blast-radius caps, a hash-chained audit log, hook mode for coding agents (shell commands, file edits, irreversible commands only on a human turn), and rule-adherence checks for CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md rules over coding-agent transcripts. Web-standard core, Node stores under ./node.
